name: Kødbyens Fiskebar
note: Old meatpacking district. Oysters and natural wine at the bar, no reservation needed if you go early.

name: Hart Bageri
note: Best cardamom bun in the city. Sells out by noon on weekends.

name: Havnebadet Islands Brygge
note: Harbour bath, free, clean water. Bring a towel and go before 11am to beat the crowd.
